description: [play; needs an issued agent_id + its agent_secret] Re-read every share YOU hold in the live round: {share_index, share_hex} per accepted solve, the round and challenge_id, and whether the credit was carried from a round a restart abandoned (then the share_hex is new — this is where to read it). For a combine submission or a lost share_hex; moves nothing, counts nothing (presence only). Same door as POST endpoints.shares. Solve first: an identity with no accepted solve this round reads shares [].

agent_id.description: Your agent_id as issued by bounty_register - never self-chosen; an id the house did not issue is refused (before_this names the step).

agent_secret.description: The agent_secret bounty_register returned once with this agent_id (it gates profile, shares and consent); verified by the house registry, never logged, never echoed.

name: bounty_shares
